f3_program: observe(at("mrs_lim.milking.frequency", "current"), 2, "times_per_day", source("twice a day"))
produce("yesterday_morning_milking", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "current"), 68, source("Yesterday morning, she got 68 gallons of milk"))
produce("yesterday_evening_milking", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "current"), 82, source("in the evening, she got 82 gallons"))
produce("this_morning_milking", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "current"), "mrs_lim.milk.this_morning.volume", source("This morning, she got 18 gallons fewer than she had yesterday morning"))
offset(event_field("this_morning_milking", "quantity"), event_field("yesterday_morning_milking", "quantity"), -18, "gallon", source("18 gallons fewer than she had yesterday morning"))
remove("afternoon_sale", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "current"), "mrs_lim.milk.afternoon_sold.volume", source("selling some gallons of milk in the afternoon"))
observe(at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "now"), 24, "gallon", source("Mrs. Lim has only 24 gallons left"))
observe(at("mrs_lim.milk.price_per_gallon", "current"), 3.5, "currency_per_gallon", source("each gallon costs $3.50"))
query("value", "mrs_lim.milk_sales.revenue")
collection("players.marbles", "marble", "sally_sam_steve", source("their marbles"))
multiple(at("sam.marbles.count", "initial"), at("steve.marbles.count", "initial"), 2, source("Sam has twice as many marbles as Steve"))
offset(at("sally.marbles.count", "initial"), at("sam.marbles.count", "initial"), -5, "count", source("Sally has 5 less than Sam"))
transfer("sam_to_sally", "sam", at("sam.marbles.count", "current"), at("sally.marbles.count", "current"), 3, source("Sam has given Sally and Steve 3 marbles each"))
transfer("sam_to_steve", "sam", at("sam.marbles.count", "current"), at("steve.marbles.count", "current"), 3, source("Sam has given Sally and Steve 3 marbles each"))
observe(at("sam.marbles.count", "now"), 8, "count", source("Sam has 8 marbles left"))
query("value", at("steve.marbles.count", "now"))

assumptions: The requested minimum depends on converting the six-foot capacity to inches, but the source supplies no feet-to-inches conversion and F3-v1 disallows inventing one.

f3_program: observe(at("rodney.commission_per_system", "current"), 25, "currency_per_system", source("a commission of $25 for each system he sells"))
collection("neighborhood.streets", "street", "neighborhood", source("a neighborhood of four streets with eight houses each"))
observe(at("neighborhood.streets.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("four streets"))
observe(at("neighborhood.houses_per_street.count", "current"), 8, "count", source("eight houses each"))

fraction_of(at("rodney.systems_sold.first_street.count", "current"), at("rodney.systems_sold.second_street.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("The first street gave him half the sales that the second street did"))
observe(at("rodney.systems_sold.third_street.count", "current"), 0, "count", source("every house on the third street turned him away"))
observe(at("rodney.systems_sold.fourth_street.count", "current"), 1, "count", source("the fourth street resulted in only one sale"))
observe(at("rodney.total_commission", "current"), 175, "currency", source("His total commission was $175"))
query("value", at("rodney.systems_sold.second_street.count", "current"))
assumptions: The statement that every third-street household turned Rodney away is treated as a direct assertion of zero third-street sales.

f3_program: collection("trees.growth_amounts", "tree_growth_amount", "trees", source("four growing trees"))
observe(at("trees.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("four growing trees"))
member("trees.growth_amounts", "trees.first.growth.amount", source("The first tree grows 1 meter/day"))
member("trees.growth_amounts", "trees.second.growth.amount", source("the second grows the same amount in half the time"))
member("trees.growth_amounts", "trees.third.growth.amount", source("the third grows 2 meters/day"))
member("trees.growth_amounts", "trees.fourth.growth.amount", source("the fourth tree grows a meter more than the third each day"))
observe(at("trees.first.growth_rate", "current"), 1, "meter_per_day", source("first tree grows 1 meter/day"))
same("trees.second.growth.amount", "trees.first.growth.amount", source("the second grows the same amount"))
fraction_of("trees.second.growth.time", "trees.first.growth.time", 1, 2, source("half the time"))
observe(at("trees.third.growth_rate", "current"), 2, "meter_per_day", source("the third grows 2 meters/day"))
offset(at("trees.fourth.growth_rate", "current"), at("trees.third.growth_rate", "current"), 1, "meter_per_day", source("the fourth tree grows a meter more than the third each day"))
query("sum", "trees.growth_amounts", "4_days")
assumptions: In the second-tree clause, “the same amount” refers to the first tree's growth amount and “half the time” compares against the first tree's growth time.
